intent: Build a Ritual Chain jigsaw puzzle dApp with browser-side gameplay and on-chain completion logging.
notes: Core game does not use async precompiles because completion logging is a normal EVM state write.
Contract address must be supplied through VITE_PUZZLE_CONTRACT_ADDRESS after deployment.
The initial puzzle layout hash is keccak256('ritual-jigsaw:v1:ritual-placeholder:4x4').
Only the deployable PuzzleCompletion contract and Foundry deploy script remain in contracts.
Puzzle can be played without connecting a wallet; wallet is only required for on-chain submission.
Pieces can now be placed on any board slot and swapped until all slots are correct.
Wallet connection now succeeds even if automatic Ritual network switching fails; submit still enforces Ritual Chain.
Ritual chain params are now added through wallet_addEthereumChain with a visible Add Ritual retry action.
On-chain lifetime points and a top-30 leaderboard have been added.
Multiple puzzle images can be added through the PUZZLES array and registered on-chain with matching layout hashes.
Leaderboard is now a separate in-app page opened from the header instead of a side panel.
Mona Lisa image was added to the puzzle manifest; future images need an explicit manifest entry.
Owner-only Admin page can batch-register missing manifest puzzles from the frontend using the deployer wallet.
Contract now supports registerPuzzles for one-transaction batch registration.
PuzzleCompletion deployed on Ritual at 0x0b040aa3C5a21F31dF830033d74154560670A12B.
Mona Lisa puzzle registered on-chain; contract puzzleCount is 2.
Ownership has not been transferred yet so the deployer can finish testing.
Admin page now supports owner-only puzzle deactivation/reactivation using setPuzzleActive.
Puzzle registration is owner-only; only the contract owner/admin can add manifest puzzle metadata on-chain.
Completion submission no longer auto-registers puzzles for players; unregistered puzzles must be registered from the owner-gated Admin page.
Completion submission uses submitCompletionByHash when the deployed contract supports it.
Frontend keeps a fallback to the legacy submitCompletion path for existing deployments that do not expose puzzleIdByLayoutHash yet.
UI was rethemed to a black-and-white high-contrast style with black surfaces, white outlines, and gray secondary text.
On-chain query confirmed deployed owner is 0xc29A7a805303C1c6E5153212b086BfE7c6EFeeA7 and it matches the private key in .env.local.
On-chain query confirmed the deployed contract already has 2 registered puzzles, so the manifest Register Puzzles button is disabled because pendingCount is 0.
Owner balance is about 1.498 RITUAL, so admin tx failure is not a zero-balance issue.
Admin page now has an owner-only Add Puzzle form that registers a public image URL/IPFS URI directly through registerPuzzle.
Frontend now reads all registered on-chain puzzles via puzzleCount/getPuzzle and adds custom URL-based puzzles to the picker.
All frontend contract writes now force legacy transaction mode by passing gasPrice from publicClient.getGasPrice and type='legacy'.
This targets the Ritual RPC error: transaction type not supported.
The latest failure was user rejected/user cancel, meaning the wallet refused to sign before broadcasting.
The local owner relayer was removed when the app was simplified to score-only submission.
User requested removing image registration entirely.
Contract is now a score-only ledger with submitScore(puzzleHash, rows, cols, moves, secondsTaken, completionHash).
Frontend no longer has Admin registration, deactivation, or relay code.
Puzzle picker now lets players paste image URLs/IPFS URIs directly; images remain frontend-only.
The old deployed address is not compatible with the new score-only ABI and must be replaced after deployment.
Local .env.local contract address was reset to zero address so the app does not call the old registration contract.
Temporary npm install solc --no-save timed out, so the new contract was not deployed from this machine.
Frontend typecheck, production build, and local dev server smoke test passed after the score-only rewrite.
Frontend typecheck and production build passed after the owner-only registration and theme changes.
Self-contained Solidity tests were added under contracts/test, but local forge/solc tools are not installed on this machine.
A Remix-bytecode deploy helper was added at scripts/deploy-remix-bytecode.mjs to send score-only contract deployment as a legacy type-0 transaction.
The helper expects contracts/PuzzleCompletion.bytecode.txt to contain Remix creation bytecode and prints the deployed contract address after the receipt succeeds.
The helper accepts either 0x-prefixed bytecode or bare Remix hex bytecode and normalizes private keys with or without a 0x prefix.
A placeholder contracts/PuzzleCompletion.bytecode.txt file was added so the user can replace it with Remix creation bytecode.
Frontend typecheck, production build, and localhost:5173 smoke test passed after adding the legacy deploy helper.
